# Kien Serapio

> Kien Leriss R. Serapio is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Wika PH, a Philippine EdTech startup dedicated to preserving and teaching regional Filipino languages. He is recognized among StellarPH's PH100 Brightest Minds Under 30 (2026). He works professionally as a software developer and AI engineer, specializing in automated workflows, offline and on-device AI, and enterprise systems. Based in Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines; works with teams in the Philippines, the United States, Canada, Australia and Singapore.

- Website: https://kienserapio.com

- Medium: https://medium.com/@kienserapio

## Wika PH (founder & CEO, Mar 2026 – present)

A language-learning app for the languages of the Philippines: Tagalog, Cebuano, Ilocano, Hiligaynon and Asi today, expanding to ten. Short lessons, quizzes, streaks and leagues, plus Dialecto, a voice AI tutor. https://wikaph.com

First month on the App Store (September 1–30, 2026; source: https://www.wikaph.com/updates/wika-ph-september-2026):
- 4,790 App Store downloads; 161+ Android beta testers
- 2,038 new learners; 2,106 total accounts by September 30
- 14,356 lessons completed; 93.5% average quiz accuracy
- 1,373 weekly active learners at peak
- 39% of learners outside the Philippines; 31% learn to connect with family
- 4.8 stars on the App Store

## Experience

- **Founder & Chief Executive Officer, Wika PH** — Manila (Mar 2026 – present).
- **Lead Software Developer, Equilife Medical** — project-based (Jul 2026 – Sept 2026). Led ATLAS, an offline-first operations platform with ten integrated modules and an AI layer (OCR, retrieval over engineering manuals, predictive maintenance). Cut routine tasks from ~2 hours to under 10 minutes (88%).
- **AI Engineering Intern, NMBLR AI Foundry** — Makati (Jun 2026 – Jul 2026). Evaluation of Forge; NMBLR Rewards; an AI agent kit for DEVCON.
- **Full Stack Development Intern, DEVCON Philippines** — Pasig (Sept 2025 – Apr 2026). Design system for DEVCON+ (11 chapters), 40% faster design-to-prototype; WordPress and SPA builds.
- **UI/UX Intern, Easybus PH** (Jul 2025 – Oct 2025).
- **Digital and Social Media Operations Intern, Globe Telecom** (Apr 2025 – Jul 2025).
- **Junior Graphic Designer, Widustalk Academy** (Feb 2023 – Aug 2023).

## Selected work (https://kienserapio.com/work)

- **Wika PH** — React Native, Expo, Supabase, Cartesia. https://kienserapio.com/work/wika-ph
- **Dialecto** — an offline AI tutor that speaks six Philippine languages (Tagalog, Cebuano, Bikol, Kapampangan, Ilocano, Hiligaynon), grounded in 89,050 dictionary entries and 24,963 example sentences; Google Gemma runs on-device (Ollama or WebGPU). https://github.com/kienserapio/Dialecto
- **ATLAS by Equilife Medical** — Next.js, Supabase, pgvector, PWA. Operations platform replacing spreadsheets and paper slips for ICU equipment rentals to ~50 hospitals; 207,614 records migrated.
- **EverythingOS** — AI-native company suite (booking, CRM, websites, design, payments). The AI composes layouts from real templates and brand assets rather than generating images. https://everythingos-landing.vercel.app
- **OneTUP** — a better TUP website and student super-app; 10 modules, 12 grounded AI features, 557 tests. https://onetup-app.vercel.app
- **Wika HQ** — internal workspace for the Wika PH team: 33 tools, an AI assistant and an MCP server.
- **DEVCON Agent Kit**, **LogMark AI** (Gemini), **WarmApp** (YOLOv8-pose), **Moni** (YOLOv8)
- Client work: **KPVE** (https://kpve.com), **KAP Group**, **SDA Rentals**, **Doc On Call**, **Rare Gem Exchange**, **ByTheWay**
- **Superkick** (1,439 matches indexed), **DEVCON+** (https://devcon.plus), **Eclipse** (Global Game Jam 2026)
